editThenRun.en-US: Optional command to run after this file edit succeeds, such as a test or build. A failed edit skips the command; a failed command keeps the edit. This command executes inside edit, not as a separate bash tool call.
editThenRun.zh-CN: 可选：文件编辑成功后执行的命令，例如测试或构建。编辑失败则跳过命令；命令失败不撤销编辑。命令在 edit 内执行，不是独立的 bash 工具调用。

writeThenRun.en-US: Optional command to run after this file write succeeds, such as a test or build. A failed write skips the command; a failed command keeps the write. This command executes inside write, not as a separate bash tool call.
writeThenRun.zh-CN: 可选：文件写入成功后执行的命令，例如测试或构建。写入失败则跳过命令；命令失败不撤销写入。命令在 write 内执行，不是独立的 bash 工具调用。

command.en-US: Bash command to run after a successful file mutation
command.zh-CN: 文件修改成功后执行的 Bash 命令

timeout.en-US: Timeout in seconds; omitted means no default timeout
timeout.zh-CN: 超时秒数；省略时无默认超时

guideline.en-US: Use then_run only when the follow-up command is already known and safe to run after this single-file mutation. Omit it when inspecting the edit result must come first.
guideline.zh-CN: 仅在已明确后续命令、且可以安全地在单文件修改后执行时使用 then_run。需要先检查编辑结果时，请省略。

invalidCommand.en-US: then_run.command must be a non-empty string.
invalidCommand.zh-CN: then_run.command 必须是非空字符串。

mutationSkipped.en-US: The file mutation did not complete successfully; the command was not run.
mutationSkipped.zh-CN: 文件修改未成功完成，未执行后续命令。

targetChanged.en-US: Target content changed before the follow-up command.
targetChanged.zh-CN: 执行后续命令前，目标文件内容发生了变化。

uiMutationUnknown.zh-CN: 修改状态未确认，见详情

savedRoundTrip.zh-CN: 已省去 1 次模型往返

configDescription.en-US: Configure Action Fusion: status, enable, or disable; reload after changes
configDescription.zh-CN: 配置 Action Fusion：status、enable 或 disable；修改后需重新加载

configSaved.en-US:
Action Fusion configured={enabled}. Run /reload to apply.
{path}
configSaved.zh-CN:
Action Fusion 配置启用={enabled}。运行 /reload 后生效。
{path}

configShape.en-US: Only the optional boolean field enabled is supported.
configShape.zh-CN: 仅支持可选的布尔字段 enabled。

configSaveFailed.en-US: Could not save Action Fusion configuration: {error}
configSaveFailed.zh-CN: 无法保存 Action Fusion 配置：{error}
